correctness.rationale: The characteristic-five gradient has unique singular point and a nondegenerate rank-three tangent quadratic. Projection from the node yields a smooth tangent conic and transverse residual cubic intersecting in exactly six points; necessity and sufficiency of q|h on projected lines proves precisely 6+15 geometric lines. The generic 15 rational and 12 quadratic lines are explicit, with a unit Pluecker coordinate. The relative Grassmannian section of rank four has finite zero locus of codimension four and is Cohen-Macaulay and flat over the DVR, rank 27. Six quadratic branch maps are surjective on local coordinate rings because p_02/p_01=t; with fifteen rational sections their ranks saturate 27. The bundled exact checker verifies the polynomial, reduction, orbit and finite-field identities, but completeness and flatness rest on the proofs.

The new statement concerns the entire finite flat relative Hilbert algebra across ramified bad reduction, its six exact length-two local rings and discriminant. value.rationale: The prime 5 is geometrically forced by the discriminant of the twelve classical nonrational lines and the singular special model. The exact ramified local rings distinguish a true sixfold pairwise collision of 27 generic lines from mere loss of reduced line supports. The special scheme retains flat length 27 but has 21 points, and its discriminant ideal is 5^6; these are natural deformation and arithmetic invariants, not arbitrary numerical slices.
